patient_summary:
The patient is feeling tired and looks pale. The doctor thinks it might be because of iron deficiency anaemia, but it's not sure yet. 

The doctor wants to do some tests: a full blood count and a ferritin test. 

The patient doesn't need to take any medicine right now. 

The doctor wants to see the patient again after the test results come back. 

If the patient feels very short of breath or has chest pain, they should go to the hospital right away.
